name: VectorCraft
summary: Edit SVG and Illustrator files in Nextcloud with VectorCraft
description:
Open an SVG, Illustrator (.ai), EPS or VectorCraft file in Files with **Edit in VectorCraft** and work on it right in the browser: the pen and shape tools, Pathfinder, gradients and patterns, type on a path, artboards, symbols and layers.

- **Save** writes the drawing straight back to Nextcloud in its own format, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version.
- **Save As**, **Save a Copy** and **Export** (PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG…) store a file in any folder you pick.
- Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy.
- If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy.
- Optionally, clicking a drawing in Files opens it in VectorCraft.
readme_features:
- **Edit in VectorCraft** appears in the Files action menu of every SVG, Illustrator (.ai), EPS and VectorCraft file you can read.
- **Save** (Ctrl/⌘+S) writes the drawing back to Nextcloud in its own format, and Nextcloud keeps the previous state as a file version.
- **Save As**, **Save a Copy** and **Export** (PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP, SVG…) ask for a name and folder in your Nextcloud the first time; VectorCraft's own Save As dialog picks the name and format first.
readme_limitations: - PDFs open in VectorCraft from its own File › Open; in Files, PDFs are left to PDF apps.
bridge_notes: With `?host=parent`, what VectorCraft would download goes to the parent instead, and the parent guards leaving the page with unsaved changes. VectorCraft's own Save As dialog still picks the name and format.
